Three arms extracted from Qureshi et al. 2021 (BMC Oral Health), a three-arm parallel RCT (n=150, 50/arm):

- **Test Group-1**: SRP (ultrasonic + hand instrumentation, full-mouth single sitting ~60 min) + systemic metronidazole 400 mg ×3 for 10 days + warm salt water rinses + OHI → `SI_plus_systemic_local_antimicrobial`
- **Test Group-2**: Same SRP + OHI (no metronidazole) → `SI_alone`
- **Control Group-3**: OHI only (delayed periodontal therapy offered at end of trial) → `usual_care`

All arms followed to 6 months (with interim assessments at 1 and 3 months).
